title.value: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED M ONKEYPOX D ETECTOR FOR R ESOURCE -C ONSTRAINED E NVIRONMENTS
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED M ONKEYPOX D ETECTOR FOR R ESOURCE -C ONSTRAINED E NVIRONMENTS

extractions.description: The paper introduces AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector designed for resource-constrained environments, particularly in least developed countries (LDCs) under the Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs) initiative. It aims to provide accessible healthcare through AI-driven diagnostics, achieving state-of-the-art performance in monkeypox detection with open-sourced code and datasets.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly mentions addressing the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG3) on health, focusing on providing healthcare access to vulnerable populations in least developed countries (LDCs).
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Particularly, AMCs answer to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG3) on health, which represents a universal recognition that health is fundamental to human capital and social and economic development

primary_category.justification: The primary focus is on providing healthcare solutions to resource-constrained environments in less developed countries.
primary_category.quote: We are developing, open sourcing, and standardizing health AI technologies to enable healthcare access in least developed countries (LDCs).

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper focuses on developing AI-based solutions and sharing the knowledge and tools to improve healthcare in resource-constrained environments.
primary_sub_category.quote: We have also open sourced both the source code and the dataset of AICOM-MP to allow health AI professionals to integrate AICOM-MP into their services. Also, through the AICOM-MP project, we have generalized a methodology of developing health AI technologies for AMCs to allow universal access even in resource-constrained environments.

applications.justification: No direct Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development applications mentioned.
